title: Vaporesso Armour Ultra Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso Armour Ultra Kit redefines the landscape of internal-battery devices, introducing the category's first "Ultra Mod." Designed for serious sub-ohm vapers who demand exceptional endurance without the hassle of external cells, the Armour Ultra integrates a colossal 5500mAh battery. This industry-leading capacity rivals that of many dual-battery setups, ensuring all-day performance even at high wattages. Capable of firing up to 100W, the device is powered by Vaporesso’s advanced AXON chipset. This chip delivers rapid firing speeds and professional modes, including Pulse Mode for consistent power delivery and F(t) Mode for enhanced flavour density. Durability is the cornerstone of the Armour series, and the Ultra takes this to the extreme. It boasts a trifecta of resistances: IP68 and IP69K ratings for superior waterproofing (including high-pressure waterjets) and dust protection, alongside MIL-STD-810H military-grade shock resistance. Tested against drops of up to 1.2 metres, this device is engineered to survive the harshest environments. The chassis is wrapped in a rugged, ergonomic TPU coating that provides excellent grip and impact absorption. The kit is crowned with the Vaporesso iTank T, a high-performance sub-ohm tank featuring a top-airflow design that virtually eliminates leaks while delivering smooth, turbulent-free DTL draws. The tank utilises the GTi Dual Mesh Coil platform, featuring COREX technology for explosive flavour. With its "Uni-Lock" secure button system and effortless top-fill mechanism, the Vaporesso Armour Ultra Kit is the new benchmark for durability and integrated power. Find the vape juice online that feels tailor-made for this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
